policy: Identical 4-base-record schedule and initialization. code_only: four staged-code targets with authored train priors. replay: two staged-code and two direct targets, rotating positions. Correct authored training code, no generated-target acceptance or reference inference assistance in autonomous mode.
training: All existing 96 staged-protocol-v1 train records; no new targets or held-out optimization.
evaluation: Before/after direct, autonomous and gold-prior code on all 96 training records; after both arms, exposed v2 validation and existing bilingual 12-prompt suite. Docker on bilingual suite; four fixed exported-runtime readouts per arm.
selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoints only; no early stopping or budget/prompt tuning using evaluation.
limits: One seed, correlated synthetic training and previously inspected regression tasks. Equal steps and batch sizes do not equalize staged-code exposure, sequence length, target bytes or compute. Gold-prior generation is assisted. No production default selection.
